_meta.purpose: Machine-readable repair guide for Altitude usage violations. Keyed by the stable error CODE emitted by the validator (cli/validate.mjs). An agent that gets a violation looks up its `code` here to learn how to fix it. Human prose lives in cli/REPAIR.md.
_meta.honesty: If no Altitude element, attribute, or value expresses what a design needs, STOP. Do not invent an attribute, hard-code a color, or reach past the design system to fake it. Report the gap — an honest 'Altitude can't express X yet' is useful signal, while a faked workaround is silent drift the next person inherits.
_meta.codesAreStable: Error codes are append-only. A code's meaning never changes and it is never removed; only the human `detail` may change.
_meta.severity: A code beginning ERR_ fails the run (exit 1). A code beginning WARN_ is advisory and exits 0 unless --strict is passed. Every violation also carries an explicit `severity` field.

ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.title: Unknown element
ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.means: An `<al-*>` tag is not a registered Altitude custom element — a typo or a hallucinated name.
ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.fix: Use a real Altitude element. If a suggestion is offered, it is the nearest registered tag. If nothing fits, do not invent one — report the gap.

ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.title: Unknown attribute
ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.means: An attribute was set that the element's contract does not declare. Lookup is case-insensitive, as HTML attributes are — `isDisabled` and `isdisabled` are the same attribute — so this fires only on a name that genuinely does not exist.
ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.fix: Remove the attribute, or replace it with a valid one from the element's contract. slot, id, class, style, part, aria-*, data-*, and event/framework bindings are always allowed.

ERR_INVALID_ENUM.title: Invalid value
ERR_INVALID_ENUM.means: An attribute was given a value outside its allowed set.
ERR_INVALID_ENUM.fix: Set the attribute to one of its allowed values. If a suggestion is offered, it is the nearest allowed value.

ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Type mismatch
ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.means: An attribute was given a value of the wrong type (e.g. a non-boolean where a boolean is expected).
ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Pass a value of the type the attribute expects (boolean attributes take true/false or bare presence).

ERR_UNKNOWN_SLOT.title: Unknown slot
ERR_UNKNOWN_SLOT.means: llms.txt rule 3. A `slot="…"` names a slot on the PARENT element, and that parent renders no slot by that name. Content aimed at a slot that does not exist is dropped from the rendered output entirely — it does not fall back to the default slot.
ERR_UNKNOWN_SLOT.fix: Point `slot` at a slot the parent element actually declares — the allowed names are listed above. To place content in the default slot, remove the `slot` attribute altogether. Do not invent a slot name: if the parent has no slot for this content, report the gap.

ERR_PHANTOM_TOKEN.title: Token that does not exist
ERR_PHANTOM_TOKEN.means: llms.txt rule 2. A `--al-*` custom property is read through `var()` that is not in the shipped token set. CSS resolves an unknown custom property silently — to its fallback, or to nothing — so the page renders and is wrong, in a way no browser error will ever tell you about.
ERR_PHANTOM_TOKEN.fix: Replace it with a real token name from the shipped set (https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-tokens.txt, or the `altitude_get_tokens` MCP tool). If a suggestion is offered, it is the nearest real token. If no token expresses what is needed, report the gap rather than inventing a plausible-looking name.

WARN_RAW_VALUE.title: Raw value where a token exists
WARN_RAW_VALUE.means: llms.txt rule 1. A hard-coded hex colour or px length appears in a declaration that styles an Altitude element, on a CSS property the token set covers. It renders identically today and then stops following brand, mode, density and contrast the moment any of those change.
WARN_RAW_VALUE.fix: Replace the literal with the `var(--al-…)` token for that role. Colours come from the --al-theme-color-* families, spacing from --al-theme-space-*, radii from --al-theme-border-radius-*, type from --al-theme-typography-*. Geometry the token set deliberately does not cover — a one-off width or height, a 1px hairline — is not flagged and needs no change.

WARN_HANDROLLED_LAYOUT.title: Hand-rolled arrangement
WARN_HANDROLLED_LAYOUT.means: llms.txt rule 5. An element sets `display: flex` or `display: grid` and arranges two or more sibling Altitude components inside it. Arrangement belongs to the layout primitive, not to ad-hoc CSS or to a new wrapper component.
WARN_HANDROLLED_LAYOUT.fix: Replace the wrapper with `<al-layout>` and express the arrangement as props: `direction`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`, `wrap`, `grow`, `stretchItems`, `responsive`, `fullHeight`, `noCollapse`, plus the `constrained` / `grid` / `bento` variants with `size` / `gutter` / `columns`. Do not create a new `*-group` wrapper — a wrapper that owns no behaviour, ARIA relationship or state is `<al-layout>` with props.

ERR_MISSING_THEME_HOST.title: No <al-theme> host
ERR_MISSING_THEME_HOST.means: llms.txt rule 4. This source is a document root — it has an `<html>`/`<body>` element or it owns registration — and it renders Altitude components with no `<al-theme>` ancestor. Tokens are set on that host, not on `:root`, so every component falls back to unthemed values.
ERR_MISSING_THEME_HOST.fix: Wrap the rendered components in `<al-theme brand="…">` (add `mode`, `density`, `contrast` or `motion` as needed). One host near the root of the document is enough — nesting more is a real SSR cost, not a safety measure. Inner fragments are never flagged: only a root is expected to carry the host.

WARN_MIXED_REGISTRATION.title: Two registration paths in one document
WARN_MIXED_REGISTRATION.means: llms.txt rule 6. This document sets `window.alAutoRegistry = true` AND takes a second registration path (importing @southleft/al-react wrappers, or calling registerAltitude({ mode: 'versioned' })). With the flag set, a deep import self-registers the plain tag first; the wrapper's suffixed define then throws NotSupportedError, which is caught and downgraded to a console.error — so the suffixed tag is never defined and the element silently never upgrades.
WARN_MIXED_REGISTRATION.fix: Pick ONE path per document. Template frameworks and plain HTML: set window.alAutoRegistry = true inline in <head> and use deep imports. React: import the wrappers from @southleft/al-react and set NO flag. Micro-frontends: set no flag and call registerAltitude({ mode: 'versioned' }). Remove whichever of the two this document is not using. See .altitude/REGISTRATION.md.

ERR_A11Y_NAME.title: No accessible name
ERR_A11Y_NAME.means: The component's own guidance states an accessible-name obligation this usage does not meet. Today that is the icon-only button: with `hideText` set the slotted text is visually hidden, so it cannot be the accessible name, and without `label` the button ships with no accessible name at all (apps/docs/src/content/guidance/button.yaml).
ERR_A11Y_NAME.fix: Add `label="…"` describing the ACTION (it becomes aria-label on both the <button> and <a> branches), put the glyph in the `before` slot, and do not also leave visible text — a hidden text node plus a label produces a redundant accessible name. `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` satisfy the obligation too.
